It is fine, since faster loss lasts longer.
It is fine if people also drink detox tea.

stem: Gajar halwa is made from carrots, milk and added sugar. Which of its sugars go in the free-sugar count?
options: Just the sugar stirred in.
The carrot and milk sugar as well.
None of it, since it is made at home.

stem: Three lunches of palak dal and roti differ only in the side. Which one lets the body take in the most iron?
options: Palak dal with lemon, and tea an hour later.
Palak dal alone, since greens give plenty of iron.
Palak dal with a cup of tea alongside it.

stem: Two nobles serve Akbar, one at 1,000 zat and one at 3,000 zat. Who likely got more pay?
options: Neither; zat set rank but not pay.
The one at 3,000.
The one at 1,000, since lower numbers ranked higher.

stem: Prakash eats no sweets but adds three spoons of ketchup to his fries. About how much free sugar is that?
options: About 12 g, near three teaspoons.
None; ketchup is a salty sauce.
About 40 g, as much as a can of soda.

stem: An aunt in Kerala forwards a message: 'Detox water is proven to burn fat.' What fits best?
options: It works if it is drunk before sunrise.
It is proven, since so many people share it.
There is no strong proof that detox works.

stem: At a Hyderabad store, a 'honey almond' cereal lists: wheat flakes, sugar, honey, almonds 2%. What is it mostly made of?
options: Honey and almonds, just as the name shows.
Wheat flakes, with sugar next in line.
Almonds, since nuts are weighed last.

stem: A valley far from the mountain passes saw little trade and has few Buddhist carvings. What best explains this?
options: Less trade meant less wealth to pay for art.
Its people did not care for art.
Faith alone made art, so trade did not matter.

stem: A farmer in Rajasthan grows bajra and moong to feed his family. Why is that pair a good fit for protein?
options: Any two crops fill gaps, so the pair does not matter.
Bajra by itself carries plenty of each block.
Millet and pulse fill each other's gap.

stem: Zero as a sign for an empty place came first. What did Brahmagupta add?
options: Proof that zero is just a gap, not a number.
The first sign for an empty place.
Rules for using zero in sums.

stem: Tara wants to be asleep by 10 pm. By about what time would her phone go away?
options: By half past nine, or a bit before.
At 9:59 pm, just before bed.
Any time, as long as the screen is dim.

stem: Lakshmi is building a house in a Kerala town and wants used kitchen water to leave without wetting the lane. Which Mohenjo-daro plan does she copy?
options: A pit in her yard, since old cities had no drains.
Letting the water run down the open lane.
A pipe from the house into a covered street drain.

stem: In an office step challenge in Hyderabad, Rina runs hard for 45 minutes twice a week. Her colleague walks briskly for 150 minutes. Whose minutes reach the weekly aim?
options: Rina, since running beats walking.
Both reach it, Rina by counting double.
The walker; Rina has just 90 minutes.

stem: A foreign firm used to send money from its head office to buy goods in India. Then it gains the right to collect local rents in a district. What happens to the money from the head office?
options: It stays the same as before.
It is no longer needed for goods.
It doubles to match the new rent.

stem: In a mixed office team in Chennai, which colleagues are more at risk of low iron?
options: Women who have periods.
Nobody; men and women need the same iron.
Those who sit at desks the whole day.

stem: A kheer recipe lists 25 g of added sugar in one bowl. How much of the day's free-sugar limit is one bowl?
options: More than the whole day's limit.
About a quarter of it.
About half of the day's limit.

stem: Why did monks from Gandhara move into Central Asia?
options: Their art style seems to have been banned at home.
Hun invasions seem to have driven them out.
Traders seem to have paid them to leave.

stem: A housing society in Pune forms a committee to write its rules. Each building's own committee picks the members. Which Assembly feature is this like?
options: Picked by the assemblies of the provinces.
Members chosen by a direct vote of the people.
Members chosen by the British king.

stem: At a Bhopal college, a small team drafts new hostel rules. Then all the student reps debate them and change many lines. Which part of the Constitution's making does this match?
options: A draft, then debate and changes.
One author writing the final text alone.
The draft passing just as it was written.

stem: An app maker in Bengaluru wants one message read in many Indian states. Following Ashoka's way, what would she do?
options: Use one script, as Ashoka did.
Use the capital's script in each state.
Write it in each region's own script.

stem: A biscuit brand cuts its serving from 30 g to 20 g, and the sugar per serving drops. Did the biscuit get less sugary?
options: Not by that; check the per 100 g line.
Yes, since brands must cut sugar to cut servings.
Yes; less sugar per serving means a less sugary biscuit.

stem: On an easy cycle ride, Rekha sings her favourite song with ease. What effort level is that?
options: Hard, since her legs keep turning the pedals.
Below moderate, since she can still sing.
Moderate, since she is moving the whole time.

stem: A letter from 1850 is signed by the Company's Governor-General in India. Does that fit the timeline?
options: No; the Company lost its powers after Plassey.
Yes; Company rule went on until 1858.
No; the Crown ruled from 1765.

stem: Which of these lines would fit in an edict about Ashoka's dhamma?
options: Pray at the king's temple for peace.
Give the king a share of your harvest each year.
Be kind to servants and respect elders.

stem: A classmate claims Dr B.R. Ambedkar wrote the whole Constitution alone. What is the best reply?
options: His team drafted it; the Assembly changed it.
True; the Assembly passed his draft without changes.
He had no part in writing it.

stem: A dance teacher in Kolkata wants her class at a vigorous effort for one song. Which check fits?

stem: A wedding caterer in Lucknow serves chole and roti with masala chai poured during the meal. Which swap helps guests take in the most iron?
options: Serve more chai, since warm drinks help digestion.
Add lemon to the chole and serve chai later.
Add a sweet, since sugar helps iron in.

stem: Asha is a healthy adult, and her daily protein need comes out at about 54 g. About how much does she weigh?
